# contact point type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contactPointType`](gmeow-contactPointType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contactPointType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/contacts`](../../slices/contacts.md)

The usage role(s) of a contact point — one or more [`gmeow:ContactPointType`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPointType.md) values (personal, work, …). Non-functional: a contact point may serve several roles, and competing standpoint-indexed classifications coexist (P9).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ContactPoint`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPoint.md) -> [`gmeow:ContactPointType`](../classes/gmeow-ContactPointType.md)

    gmeow:contactPointType     gmeow:contactPointTypeWork ;

# --- Reified postal address: components are coordinates in the postal frame (P11).
ex:homeAddress a gmeow:PostalAddress ;
    gmeow:contactPointType   gmeow:contactPointTypePersonal ;
    gmeow:postalAddressFrame gmeow:referenceFramePostalAddress ;
    gmeow:streetAddress      "742 Evergreen Terrace" ;
    gmeow:addressLocality    "Springfield" ;
    gmeow:addressRegion      "Oregon" ;
    gmeow:postalCode         "97403" ;
